{{Recipe summary
| Category = Soup recipes
| Difficulty = 1
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
*8 [[Cookbook:Gallon|gallons]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
*5 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] [[Cookbook:Barley|barley]] meal
*4 [[Cookbook:Herring|herrings]], meat pounded
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]], [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]], and [[Cookbook:Herb|herbs]], to taste

==Procedure==

#Combine water and barley meal.
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] it to the consistency of a thick jelly. 
#Season it with salt, pepper, vinegar, sweet herbs. Add the herring meat.
